Name: SOUND_CHR_PHYSICS_SE_PARAM_ST
Description: Contact sounds for a character's ragdoll (dead bodies). Row ID = the character's model number (4200 for c4200). Not used for the player character. A row with both Ground Contact and Player Contact SE IDs at -1 is ignored.

Fields.Name: Ground Contact - SE ID
Fields.Description: Character sound (c) played at the contact point when a listed ragdoll body hits the ground or other non-character collision; the ground's material is passed to the sound. Plays only within 0.5 s of the body's first ground contact (of the character's, when counted per character), at most every 0.25 s. -1: no ground sound.

Fields.Name: Ground Contact - Additional SE ID
Fields.Description: Second character sound (c) played on the same emitter together with the ground contact sound. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Ground Contact - Play Count
Fields.Description: How many times the ground contact sound can play: per listed body, or for the whole character (at most 16), see Count Plays per Body.

Fields.Name: Count Plays per Body
Fields.Description: On: each listed body can play the ground sound up to Play Count times, with its own 0.5 s window. Off: Play Count and the 0.5 s window are shared by the whole character.

Fields.Name: Ground Contact - Min Impulse
Fields.Description: Smallest contact impulse that plays the ground sound (the largest impulse among the contact points is compared).

Fields.Name: Ground Contact - Min Speed
Fields.Description: Smallest body speed (m/s) at the contact that plays the ground sound.

Fields.Name: Player Contact - SE ID
Fields.Description: Character sound (c) played at the contact point when a listed ragdoll body touches the local player character. At most every 0.25 s per body, no play count limit. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Player Contact - Min Impulse
Fields.Description: Smallest contact impulse that plays the player contact sound (the largest impulse among the contact points is compared).

Fields.Name: Player Contact - Min Speed
Fields.Description: Smallest body speed (m/s) at the contact that plays the player contact sound.

Fields.Name: Contact Body Index [0]
Fields.Description: Ragdoll body index that gets contact sounds. Up to 16 bodies, each checked and counted on its own.
